name: RevoiceLive
detailed_description:
Change your online voice with RevoiceLive, the easy-to-use app for macOS and Windows. Perfect for Zoom, Discord, and Google Meet, it allows you to change your voice effortlessly. Simply activate Voice Conversion in RevoiceLive app, select RevoiceAudioDevice (on mac) or Voicemod (on win) as your microphone in your VoIP app, and start speaking.

Key Features

  • Real-Time Transformation: Change your voice instantly, without any delay—ideal for live conversations and streaming.

  • Seamless Integration: Compatible with all major VoIP platforms like Zoom and Discord, RevoiceLive works smoothly without needing extra setup.

  • Intuitive Design: Our straightforward interface lets anyone alter their voice easily, no matter their tech skill level.

Warning

  • Use headphones or enable echo cancellation (Windows only) during calls to prevent acoustic feedback.

  • We are working to extend support for other languages, for now works well with english only!

  • The conversion relies on CPU by default, but can be run on GPU (Windows only) in order to free up the processor.

Explore additional voice options at our website. Use responsibly.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.2 GHz
  • Memory: 200 MB RAM
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Run on GPU if it is available in your system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 12.0
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Graphics: None
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
